subject: Comp package proposal for contingent hire Samir Patel
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@talentworks.com>
To: maya_srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Candidate update - Samir Patel (contingent)

Hi Maya / Laura —

Quick heads up: Samir Patel (senior infra engineer) finished his final onsite yesterday and is very enthusiastic about Redwood. He asked me to share a few details that matter for conversion to FTE — specifically target base, RSU range, and preferred start window (mid-August).

I attached his latest resume for reference. He is currently working as a contractor through TalentWorks and is eligible for conversion at the end of his current statement of work (Aug 2). He asked whether Redwood can offer something close to market for SRE/infra (San Francisco market).

Can you advise on an initial package that we should present? Samir would like to see a written offer first before notifying his agency.

Thanks,
Jordan
TalentWorks — Senior Technical Recruiter
jordan.lee@talentworks.com
Attachment: Samir_Patel_Resume.pdf
From: maya_srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate update - Samir Patel (contingent)

Thanks Jordan — forwarding to finance and People Ops for comp / headcount sign-off. Quick context for internal reviewers: Samir has been contracting with us on a tier-2 infra project for 6 months, has full access to staging, and has been consistently rated excellent by the Eng lead. We want to convert him to FTE on 2025-08-11 (first Monday after his SOW end) if approvals come through.

Proposed package (draft):
- Title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
- Base salary: $180,000
- Signing bonus: $7,500 (one-time)
- RSUs: 4,000 RSUs vesting over 4y with 1y cliff (comp band midpoint is 3,800–5,200 for Sr SRE)
- Manager: Derek Huang (eng)
- Target start: 2025-08-11
- Reason: retention + knowledge transfer (cost neutral within 6 months vs current contract rate)

Attachments: offer summary with band reference and proposed DocuSign template (Samir_Offer_Summary_Q3_2025.pdf, Comp_Bands_Q2_2025.xlsx).

Laura — please confirm there is headcount/comp budget for this spot (headcount is currently in the infra team bucket). Marissa / Tessa — I plan to send candidate-facing offer after finance okays. If anyone has concerns about RSU amount or signing bonus, call them out.

Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: maya_srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 08:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Candidate update - Samir Patel (contingent)

Thanks for the context — looks reasonable, but two finance notes before we proceed: 1) Headcount: we have one remaining committed FTE for Q3 in the infra bucket (Workday-Ticket-98765). Approving conversion will consume that. 2) Comp structure: $180k base + 4,000 RSUs is slightly above midpoint for our current comp bands for Sr SRE in SF. Can the team confirm that the role's band justification (retention & immediate value) is documented in the hiring packet?

I'd also prefer if we reduce the signing bonus to $5,000 and make it pro-rated if the candidate starts after Aug 15. That keeps the total cash nearer our target comp. If you want to keep $7,500, we need an exception routed through PeopleOps headcount policy (simple form).

If you can confirm acceptance of the $5,000 signing bonus and that the hire will use the existing Q3 headcount, we can route finance approval today and I will clear payroll setup.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Finance Business Partner — People & GTM
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: maya_srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@talentworks.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate update - Samir Patel (contingent)

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Per People Ops I confirm:
- We will use the infra team's committed Q3 headcount for the conversion (Workday-Ticket-98765).
- Signing bonus adjusted to $5,000, pro-rated if start > 2025-08-15.
- RSU grant: 4,000 is approved as-is based on retention case and peer comps in Comp_Bands_Q2_2025.xlsx.

Next steps: Laura to confirm final finance sign-off (I flagged payroll lead). Once Laura gives the go-ahead, I'll prepare the DocuSign packet and copy Jordan to coordinate candidate signature. Jordan — please confirm Samir's official last contractor day (so we can set the start/termination dates correctly).

Forwarded message below — candidate confirmed tentative acceptance pending written offer:

> From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@gmail.com>
> To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@talentworks.com>
> Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:50:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: Quick question on start date
>
> Thanks — mid-August works great. If Redwood can get an offer to me by next week I can sign and wrap up my current contractor run. Appreciate the help.
>
> — Samir

Marissa Cole
Senior People Partner
Redwood Inference
